messages:
dani: Heads up — planning to roll 1.23.0 at 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC (~40m). No DB migrations. Main risk is p99 tokenization spike. Rolling across pool-a/b/c, canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

samir: I'm rollback owner. I'll be available +1 if needed. Rollback criteria: error rate > 2.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 350ms for 5m. Also any failing smoke checks.

lex: Smoke checklist quick rundown:
1) `GET /health` on all pods
2) simple chat generation (8–16 tokens)
3) embeddings sanity check
4) trace/span present and sampling looks normal
I'll run these after the canary warms up.

paul: Can we include automatic fallback to `rwd-llm-v1-quant` as an escape route? If canary fails, route to v1-quant and create a ticket.

dani: yes — routing policy already has fallback to v1-quant. Plan: canary 10% for 10m, if green -> 50% for 10m, then 100%. Any objections?

rebecca: Quick Q — who's running the rollback command if we need it? samir or infra oncall? @oncall-bot?

samir: I'll be the primary to run rollback; infra oncall will assist with traffic flip. Rollback command (local quick):

```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl set image deploy/llm-runtime llm=redwood/llm:1.22.9 --namespace=prod
./scripts/verify-smoke.sh --quick
```

samir: If I trigger rollback, I'll also post to #incidents and tag `@sre-oncall`.

dani: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-llm — condensed steps near the top for quick undo.

lex: I'll publish smoke script output (stdout+checks) to this thread. Primary metrics to watch: error rate, p50/p95 latency, token cost drift, and any embedding drift alerts.

paul: 👍 I'll stand by to open the support bridge and hand off paging if needed.

deploy-bot: deployment started: canary @ pool-a (10%) — build 1.23.0 (seq 459)

dani: Thanks — everyone keep an eye. If no major regressions by 16:20 UTC we proceed to 50%. Post any fails in-thread and ping `@oncall-bot` for escalation.
